title: Mind the Inclusivity Gap: Multilingual Gender-Neutral Translation Evaluation with mGENTE

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating instruction-following language models on a curated multilingual benchmark (mGeNTE) to test their ability to recognize ambiguous versus explicitly gendered source sentences and produce appropriate gender-neutral or correctly gendered translations. The evaluation employs an LLM-as-a-judge approach for sentence-level neutrality judgments, complemented by interpretability tools (AttnLRP) to analyze context attribution.
